name: reiad-website
//: The repository's own build tools, and nothing else.
This site has no build step in CI and is not an npm project:
it deploys by uploading aab/. There are three other
package.json files here and each one is a real workspace,
app/ for the React builds, next/ for the Next.js Worker, and
shared/ for the package both import.
This one exists because scripts/ builds committed artefacts
and was reaching for tools it had never declared.
build-modules.mjs runs tsc and build-styles.mjs runs the
Tailwind CLI; both worked on a laptop that happened to have
them and would have failed on one that did not, which is the
kind of thing that is discovered by somebody else.
Nothing here is shipped. No dependency below is imported by
any file the browser or either Worker loads.
The one script below is not a build step either. It is the
deploy command written down where a person looking for it will
find it: next/ has `npm run deploy`, this did not, and a
Cloudflare build command filled in with the familiar one failed
on `Missing script: "deploy"`. It runs wrangler and nothing
else, so it stays true to SETUP.md rather than becoming a
second description of how this deploys.
